sheets.credit: East Kazakhstan Geological Administration; editor M. G. Khisamutdinov. Scan via geokniga.org.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Scan-derived assets excluded from repository software license.
sheets.accuracy: Native scan has no readable latitude/longitude labels at the frame. Coordinate evidence is the supplied georeferenced TIFF, not independently read GCPs. Feature holdout measures image transfer only, not geographic accuracy; original TIFF registration provenance/datum conversion unknown. Provisional.
sheets.limitations: Approximate color segmentation, not interpreted contacts. Hatches/text are not independently classified. Similar colors list candidates. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Source TIFF georeferencing has no independent geographic verification.
